newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Solidere shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday as A shares fell to $109.25 from Friday's $110 and B shares were steady at $114.
Turnover in Solidere shares fell to 5,628 shares from 7,010 on Friday and value was $624,212 from $839,586.25.
There was no trade in the shares of the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.08 percent to 81.39 and the BLOM stock index also fell 0.21 percent to 935.76
